name: Uzzi
overview: Uzzi was a male member of the tribe of Issachar, known specifically as the son of Tola. His identity is primarily grounded in his lineage as recorded in 1 Chronicles 7:2, with no additional personal notes provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Uzzi means 'y-h-v-h is [my] strength,' reflecting a declaration of divine empowerment. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a strong theistic significance.
familyAndRelationships: Uzzi is explicitly identified as the son of Tola. Additionally, it is inferred that his father was Izrahiah, linking Uzzi within a genealogical line in the tribe of Issachar. No further family relationships are recorded beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Uzzi's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Issachar, highlighting the faithful preservation of God's chosen lineage. His name and lineage emphasize the strength derived from the Lord, underscoring the importance of divine empowerment in the heritage of God's people.
